scope_circle_id.description: Optional reference to an intra-Realm Circle that defines this Morph's encryption scope. Omitted means Realm-default encryption scope. Reducer enforces scope_circle_id.realm_id == Morph.realm_id and stamps immutable effective_scope onto emitted events.

schema_refs.description: Authoritative schema set for Morph fields and transition validation. Reducers MUST validate fields against exactly these refs; morph_type and facets are not a replacement for schema_refs.

state.description: Morph lifecycle state. 'active' is the default. Reducer enforces transitions per common-fields.md §5.1: cx.morph.archive MUST come from 'active' (else failed_precondition reason=morph_not_active); cx.morph.restore MUST come from 'archived' (else morph_not_archived); cx.redaction targeting the morph MUST come from {'active','archived'} (else morph_already_terminal). Same-state self-transitions MUST fail. 'redacted' is the irreversible terminal.

state_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent state transition. MUST be set when state != 'active'; MUST be the created_at of the corresponding cx.morph.archive / cx.morph.restore / redaction Event. Aligns with Space.state_changed_at and the common-fields rule in models/common-fields.md §3.

stage.description: Morph business-progression stage. Orthogonal to top-level 'state' (physical lifecycle). Required on cx.morph.create (no protocol-level default). The only wire path that mutates stage is the dedicated cx.morph.stage.set event; cx.morph.update / cx.morph.schema_migrate patches on stage / stage_changed_at MUST be rejected (schema_violation, single-source). Stage transitions intentionally do NOT carry a reason / note field — the cx.morph.stage.set event log is the audit source; human-readable explanations belong in a Message on an associated discussion track that references the event. See models/common-fields.md §5.3 for full semantics.

stage_changed_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp of the most recent stage transition. MUST be ignored when present on wire; reducer overwrites with the triggering cx.morph.stage.set event's created_at. Same-value self-transitions MUST NOT update this field.

not.$comment: Reject legacy discriminator `type`, legacy composite child array name `blocks`, and byte-count field `size`; canonical content blocks use `kind`, composite children use `parts`, and byte counts use `size_bytes`.
